def prepare(name):

        norm=backup/('normalized'+stage)/name
        norm.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        norm.write_text(formatter.format_text(raw, str(repo/name)))
        stages[stage]=norm
    if '2' not in stages:
        return {'path':name, 'result':'deleted-on-branch', 'incoming_format_only':stages['1'].read_bytes()==stages['3'].read_bytes()}
